requirement: Payment terms must specify a clear payment period of no more than 30 days from invoice date.
description: The contract should clearly define when payment is due. Payment periods longer than 30 days increase payment and cash-flow risk.

requirement: Termination for convenience must provide at least 30 days written notice.
description: A reasonable notice period should be provided before termination for convenience.

requirement: Liability should include a clearly defined limitation or liability cap.
description: The contract should clearly define the extent or maximum amount of liability.

requirement: The contract must contain a clearly defined indemnification obligation identifying the responsible party and covered claims.
description: Indemnification responsibilities should be explicitly defined to avoid uncertainty regarding covered losses or claims.

requirement: Confidential information must be protected and the confidentiality obligation should survive termination for at least 2 years.
description: Confidentiality obligations should continue after the contract ends to protect sensitive information.

requirement: The contract must clearly specify ownership or permitted rights for intellectual property created under the agreement.
description: Intellectual property ownership and usage rights should be explicitly defined.

requirement: The contract must define data protection responsibilities and require appropriate protection of personal or sensitive data.
description: The contract should establish responsibilities for protecting personal and sensitive data.

requirement: The contract must specify a governing law and jurisdiction.
description: The applicable governing law and jurisdiction should be explicitly stated.
